admin_reset: {user} active, in the admin group, new password set.
description:
NetOps console users CLI (SQLite access database: runs/netops.db).

Normal use = screen System → Users. This CLI is the RECOVERY path (admin forgot the password,
disabled themselves, deleted the wrong group) and for automation. It runs as root on the server — whoever has
a shell here already owns everything. Never pass a password as an argument: getpass (hidden input) or --password-stdin.

Subcommands:
    list                         users, groups, last login, open sessions
    groups                       access groups and permissions
    add <e-mail> [--groups g1,g2] [--admin] [--name "Name"] [--temp] [--id john]   (login = e-mail)
    passwd <id|e-mail> [--temp]       sets a new password (ends the sessions; --temp = must change)
    reset-admin [--user admin] [--email a@b.com]   creates/re-enables the admin and sets a new password
    disable <id|e-mail> | enable <id|e-mail> | delete <id|e-mail>
    sessions [--user u] | logout <id|e-mail>|--all
    audit [--user u] [--action a] [--limit 50]
    snapshot <destination.db>    consistent copy of the database (safe with the console running)
    setup-link [--port N] [--hours 24]   generates (again) the FIRST ACCESS link (#setup?token=...)

--data-root: data root (default: NETOPS_UI_DATA_ROOT or the project root).
help_id: internal ID (default: derived from the e-mail)
help_quiet: only the URLs, one per line (for the installer)
no_users: No users — console in master-password mode (the 1st login creates the admin).
setup_done: First access was already completed (there is a vault/user). To recover the admin: reset-admin
setup_link_header: First access: open one of the links below (valid for {hours} h; generating again invalidates this one):
